headline: France to deploy 70,000 police to prevent repeat of riots
summary: Elite security teams and armoured vehicles will be mobilised nationwide to stop looters and violent activists from targeting public buildings.
details: France is deploying 70,000 police officers across the country to prevent a repeat of the violence and looting that occurred last weekend. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez stated that the government will be uncompromising with rioters and looters.
caption:
70,000 police officers are hitting the streets of France to stop a wave of nationwide riots and looting.

headline: 22,000 passengers affected as 141 flights to Saudi Arabia disrupted
summary: Flight restrictions at Saudi airports due to Houthi attacks have led to cancellations and postponements of both direct and transit flights from Bangladesh.
details: According to the Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh (CAAB), 141 flights—including 66 direct and 75 transit flights—have been disrupted. This has affected approximately 21,933 passengers.
caption:
